biggest_catch: The $325 annual fee eats the bonus: at a conservative 1 cent per point for travel, the max 100,000-point offer is worth about $1,000, so year-one net is roughly $675 — only if you get the full 100,000 (most applicants are offered less) and only if you were already going to spend $8,000 in six months.
catches: Only claim this bonus if you were ALREADY going to spend $8,000 in six months — never spend extra to chase a bonus.
The $325 annual fee eats the bonus: even at the max offer the year-one net is ~$675 (100,000 pts at ~1 cent each minus $325), and your offer may be lower.
The advertised number is 'as high as' 100,000 — Amex reveals your exact offer during the application; it can be less, or you may be told you are not eligible for any offer.
Applying triggers a hard credit inquiry.
Once-per-lifetime rule: you can only ever earn the Gold Card welcome bonus once — not eligible if you have or have had this card or previous versions.

Amex's bonus-eligibility check can show a pop-up during the application denying the welcome offer based on your history (cards opened/closed, prior bonuses); you can withdraw before the inquiry if that happens.
Carrying a balance at ~20%+ APR wipes out the bonus instantly — pay in full every month.
Returned purchases, fees, and cash equivalents don't count toward the $8,000 threshold.

steps: Open the official Amex offers page and start the Gold Card application from americanexpress.com — not from an affiliate link with different terms.
Read the exact offer Amex shows you during the application; if it is below 100,000 points or a no-bonus pop-up appears, withdraw before the hard inquiry.
If approved, spend $8,000 on purchases you were already planning within the first 6 months of Card Membership.
Pay the balance in full every month — interest at ~20%+ APR wipes out the bonus.
Keep the account open and in good standing; bonus posts 8-12 weeks after you hit the threshold.
Redeem points for travel or transfer to airline/hotel partners for roughly 1 cent+ per point.
timing: Bonus Membership Rewards points are credited 8-12 weeks after you meet the $8,000 spend threshold.
